selectionBasis: Purposeful sample of six earlier-listed USDT perpetual contracts not present in the visible project plans, manifests or cache receipts. Selected for an intended common long data window; not selected by observed returns, formal market-cap/liquidity ranking, or an exhaustive exchange-universe sampling rule.
limitations: Negative evidence is limited to the listed workspace plans, manifests and two cache receipt trees; it cannot establish absence of outside human knowledge or unrecorded work.
This is an asset holdout within a previously studied market period, not a chronological future holdout. Crypto assets share market regimes and correlated risks.
The purposeful current-survivor universe retains availability and survivorship bias; it is not representative of all originally listed futures.
No new-symbol ZIP/CSV prices or strategy returns were inspected for this preflight. Official CHECKSUM availability alone does not establish minute completeness.
